rule.statement: A plaintiff is entitled to recover interest on the capital sum from the date of decree till the date of payment, but in exceptional circumstances, the interest may be limited to the capital sum.
rule.supporting_quote: Although the general rule is that, a plaintiff is entitled to recover interest from the date of decree till the date of payment, I am of the view that, in the circumstances of this particular case, it is fit and proper and equitable to limit the interest that may be recovered to a sum equivalent to the capital sum of Rs.1,312,022/-.
